items.title: PoC released: CVE-2026-66917
items.description: IDOR + Stored XSS via Broken Object-Level Authorization in JoomGallery
items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high
items.ai_summary: A proof-of-concept has been released for CVE-2026-66917, detailing an Insecure Direct Object Reference combined with Stored Cross-Site Scripting due to broken object-level authorization in JoomGallery. Attackers can leverage these flaws to access unauthorized objects and inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by other users. This can lead to session hijacking or unauthorized data exposure within the application. Web administrators should patch the JoomGallery component immediately to resolve the authorization checks.
items.why_it_matters: Website administrators running JoomGallery must update the plugin promptly to prevent stored XSS and authorization bypasses.

items.title: PoC released: CVE-2026-10053
items.description: Reproducible lab for CVE-2026-10053 (GitLab npm package-registry path traversal -> arbitrary file write as git). Vulnerable 19.2.1 vs patched 19.2.2, deterministic oracle.
items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high
items.ai_summary: CVE-2026-10053 is a path traversal vulnerability in the npm package-registry component of GitLab version 19.2.1, allowing arbitrary file write operations as the git user. The vulnerability relies on a deterministic oracle exploited via the package registry endpoints. Successful exploitation can lead to full system compromise or code execution within the context of the git user account. Mitigation requires immediately upgrading GitLab instances to version 19.2.2 or later.
items.why_it_matters: GitLab administrators must patch or upgrade to version 19.2.2 immediately to prevent remote code execution.

items.title: PoC released: CVE-2026-15718
items.description: PoC exploit chain for CVE-2026-15718: SpiderMonkey wasm baseline compiler array.fill missing-sync -> invalid pointer -> addrOf/fakeobj -> arbitrary R/W -> RCE
items.cwe_name: CWE-763 Release of Invalid Pointer or Reference
items.priority_rationale: Public PoC on GitHub · EPSS 0.4% · CVSS 4.3
items.action_detail: Exploitation is plausible and impact is high
items.ai_summary: CVE-2026-15718 is a vulnerability in the SpiderMonkey WebAssembly baseline compiler caused by a missing sync operation in array.fill, leading to an invalid pointer dereference. Attackers can leverage this flaw to achieve arbitrary read and write capabilities, resulting in remote code execution. A proof-of-concept exploit chain has been publicly released, demonstrating the validity of the attack vector. Users must update their affected browser or engine components to the latest patched version.
items.why_it_matters: Security teams managing browsers or runtimes embedding SpiderMonkey should apply vendor updates as soon as they become available.
